saints.name: Seven Holy Servite Founders
saints.summary: The Seven Holy Servite Founders were a group of men from Florence who dedicated their lives to God in the mid-13th century. They formed the Order of the Servants of Mary after receiving a vision from the Blessed Virgin Mary, encouraging them to live a life of prayer and penance. Their commitment led to the establishment of a religious order that grew significantly throughout Europe and beyond.

saints.name: Benedict of Anian
saints.legacy: Restorer of monastic discipline and unity
saints.summary: Benedict of Anian was a prominent abbot and reformer of monastic life in the 8th century. He is known for restoring monastic discipline and establishing a unified rule for monks in the West, based on the Rule of Saint Benedict. His efforts significantly influenced the development of monasticism in France and Germany, leading to a revival of spiritual fervor among monks.
